meta.hypothesis: Do pre-existing (2022 census) development conditions predict how an upazila voted in Feb 2026, sub-district complement to the e-GP project's district-level 'does winning pay' study -- run in the reverse causal direction of necessity, since the census predates the election and there is no post-election wave to test the forward direction at this level.
meta.method: Cross-sectional OLS, division fixed effects, log(registered voters) control, cluster-robust SEs by district. Predictors are z-scored so coefficients are vote-share points per one-SD change in the indicator. NOT a panel/DiD design -- see the caveats in the write-up for why this can't fully identify causality.
